messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look list of the long weekends you’ll see in Canada during 2023.  (All dates are in the local time zone of the holiday; the “observed” dates are the ones actually taken off work when the holiday falls on a weekend.)

| Long Weekend | Dates (2023) | Holiday(s) |
|--------------|--------------|------------|
| New Year’s Day (observed) | **Jan 1 – Jan 3** | New Year’s Day (Sunday) + observed on Monday, Jan 2 |
| Family Day (Ontario, AB, BC, NB, PEI, SK) | **Feb 18 – Feb 20** | Family Day (Monday) |
| Good Friday | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | Good Friday (Friday) |
| Easter Monday (some provinces) | **Apr 8 – Apr 10** | Easter Monday (Monday) |
| Victoria Day | **May 20 – May 22** | Victoria Day (Monday) |
| Canada Day (observed) | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Canada Day (Saturday) + observed on Monday, Jul 3 |
| Labour Day | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** | Labour Day (Monday) |
| Thanksgiving | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** | Thanksgiving (Monday) |
| Remembrance Day | **Nov 9 – Nov 11** | Remembrance Day (Monday) |
| Christmas & Boxing Day | **Dec 23 – Dec 26** | Christmas (Monday) + Boxing Day (Tuesday) |

**Quick notes**

* Some provinces (e.g., British Columbia, Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) observe Family Day on the third Monday in February.  
* Easter Monday is observed in several provinces (BC, Ontario, PEI, SK, NB, NL, and some territories).  
* The “observed” dates are the ones that most employers give as a day off when the statutory holiday falls on a weekend.  

Feel free to plug these date ranges into your holiday‑planning app!
